text:
mia: FYI I was triaging the Optimize toolkit docs and noticed a couple of issues from the obsidian export: some example links now point to /assets/obsidian/... which 404 on the static site, and one SDK snippet is still v1 API. We should do a small migration PR that swaps paths and updates snippets to v2.
sam: Thanks for catching this. Which exact pages?
mia: /optimize/batching.md (it links to /examples/old-sdk/kv-prefetch.md via an obsidian asset) and /optimize/quant-profiles.md (uses BatchClient from v1).
kai: I can do the batching.md path fixes. Do we want to replace the old examples with v2 snippets or leave both with a deprecation note?
mia: My preference: replace with v2 and add a tiny "If you're on v1" migration blurb. Keep it simple so new users don't get confused.
ashley: I'll take quant-profiles.md and add guidance about short-sequence fallbacks plus a warning about metric regressions when combining aggressive quantization and batching. Need the exact v2 snippet to paste though.
sam: Here's the canonical v2 example for the docs (keep it minimal):
```python
from redwood import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
profile = {
  "name": "shortseq-fallback",
  "heuristics": {"short_seq_threshold": 64, "fallback_model": "redwood/small-compat"}
}
client.apply_quant_profile(profile)
```
kai: For batching.md the obsidian export also added leading /assets/obsidian/ in a couple of image paths. I'll normalize those to /static/examples/... and add redirects for old links in the staging config.
mia: Also let's add a short snippet showing prefetch_window interacting with KV caching. Support gets questions on this a lot; recommending prefetch_window=8 for high-variance prompts addressed many tickets.
sam: I can add a tiny working snippet:
```py
# prefetch + kv cache
from redwood import OptimizeClient
oc = OptimizeClient()
oc.optimize_route("/generate", prefetch_window=8, kv_cache=True)
```
ashley: Two editorial notes for quant-profiles: 1) brief explanation of why short_seq_threshold matters (chat vs single-token scoring), and 2) a short how-to: add a small eval prompt set and check token-level perplexity after changes.
kai: I also found one example using snake_case `kv_prefetch` while the SDK uses `kv_prefetch_enabled`. I'll standardize to `kv_prefetch_enabled` across the examples.
mia: Can we also add a short mapping table in the migration note: v1 class -> v2 equivalent (e.g., `BatchClient` -> `OptimizeClient.optimize_route`)? That reduces support churn.
sam: I'll draft that table in the PR. Plan: two lightweight PRs so reviews are focused: one for link/path fixes (#? drafted by kai) and one for snippet + migration note + table (#? by sam).
opsbot: PR #7910 opened by kai: batching path fixes (draft).
docs-bot: lint/links check queued for PR #7910 (job 5032).
opsbot: PR #7911 opened by sam: snippets + migration guidance (draft).
ashley: I'll review #7911 and add the regression-monitoring paragraph. Also will suggest a short checklist for docs authors to run snippet smoke tests.
mia: Checklist suggestion: 1) verify link targets, 2) run docs-ci link/lint, 3) run snippet in small container with redwood/small-compat, 4) add migration blurb if API changed. Can someone add that to both PR templates?
ai: (not a real person) I meant "kai"; ignore stray autocorrect.
kai: Checklist added to #7910. Sam, can you add it to #7911?
sam: Done. I also ran a local mkdocs build to confirm the code fences render.
docs-bot: docs-ci: PR #7911 lint/links passed; mkdocs build passed. PR #7910 failed mkdocs due to missing asset path (job 5036).
kai: Patch incoming for the asset reference on #7910. I'll replace obsidian-assets with /static/examples and add a stub redirect.
ashley: When we merge, please add a changelog entry under docs/CHANGELOG.md noting "Optimize: migrated SDK snippets to v2; fixed obsidian-export paths; added prefetch/PV guidance". Keep it terse.
mia: Timeline: can we land both before the Tuesday release snapshot? Sam and kai aim for Monday EOD for drafts to be review-ready. Ashley will review Tue morning. I'll run final smoke after merge.
sam: Sounds good. I'll also include a tiny note in the migration blurb about behavior differences: `prefetch_window` influences request batching heuristics vs `batch_size` which controls server-side grouping.
kai: All set to push asset path fix now.
opsbot: docs-ci: PR #7910 lint/links passed after patch; mkdocs build passed (job 5041).
docs-bot: Please add reviewers: @ashley, @mia, @eng-docs for both PRs.
mia: Thanks team. Ping me if any of the sample runs fail; I'll help repro locally. :rocket:
